name: TC-4: Registration — required field 'Пароль' left empty
description: Verify that leaving a required registration field empty shows a validation error below that field and keeps the 'Зареєструватися' button disabled.
descriptionHtml: Verify that leaving a required registration field empty shows a validation error below that field and keeps the 'Зареєструватися' button disabled.

testStage.description: Verify that leaving a required registration field empty shows a validation error below that field and keeps the 'Зареєструватися' button disabled.

steps.name: Click the user icon and choose 'Зареєструватися' in the opened dropdown
Check if Registration modal is displayed
Check if Registration modal is displayed
Fill all fields with data EXCEPT 'Пароль' (leave empty)
Wait for a specific validation error to appear
Get all displayed validation error messages in the form
Get all displayed validation error messages in the form
Check if Submit button ('Зареєструватися') is enabled
